title: Declare the Next.js deployment preset in source control
context: Deployment dpl_Aht8GraUB12zBJaasbVcWZgdLg9f built commit dd6dae4 successfully but failed looking for public. The Vercel project API returned a null framework preset.
options: Set the framework only in the Vercel dashboard
Declare the Next.js preset in vercel.json
choice: Declare nextjs in vercel.json and retain npm run build so the content and byte-budget checks run on Vercel.
tradeoff: The repository now contains provider-specific configuration, but the preset travels with each reviewed commit.
